arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from pod reserve. My jobs: (1) keep the pod honest: watch ratio of pod power to boat-model power and heart rate vs pod power; if pod drifts, set pod_gain. (2) Watch local push for weed/drag drops; clear_rudder if pacer misses it. (3) Track course length; act on radio messages (set_race_distance + tell). (4) Check critical power by heart-rate trend mid-race; at ~1500 m to go decide if a finish push is warranted. Baseline ratio shaft/boat ~1.67-1.71 at start.

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from pod reserve (test CP 173 W shaft, 14.8 kJ). DONE: pod drifted high ~410-470 s, set pod_gain 1.17 (watch for further drift: pod_boat_ratio normal ~1.6-1.72). Belief: true CP ~188 W (HR flat at ~188 W true with model reserve empty). Jobs: (1) keep pod honest (ratio watch, same-direction GPS vs pod). (2) weed/drag: push_local drop in BOTH directions -> clear_rudder if pacer misses. (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (4) Finish: pacer finish rule needs pod reserve >40% at 800 m to go, will not fire with test CP; if HR/speed say reserve left, use a +effort piece from ~900-1000 m to go (sized with test_cost).

Paddler 7/10 hard but holding. Raw pod 255 (corrected 218) but HR only 176->178: possible further pod drift; recheck on clean leg-3 data (after ~670 s). Idea: ease ~10% on tailwind leg 4, spend into headwind leg 5 / finish (optimal-pacing gain ~3 s if fully followed).

arguments.text: RACE 5000 m (shortened by radio at 621 s; computer set, paddler told). Legs: 3 out (headwind), 4 back (tailwind), 5 out to finish (headwind). New wind/current ~0.27 m/s since ~540 s. Pod drift corrected (gain 1.17 since 410 s). Weed caught ~730-830 s, cleared by pacer clear_rudder at 823 s (push_local back to ~-0.27 = wind only). Paddler BLEW UP at ~845 s after holding ~218 W since the shorter-course news; true CP ~188 W (183-195), W prime ~ test 14.8 kJ. NOW: let them recover on tailwind leg 4; watch overcook (>205 W). Finish: at ~1080 m to go decide a final piece from true reserve (CP 188); pacer finish rule at 800 m needs test-CP pod reserve >40%. Do not cue in the pacer way unless needed (shared 60 s gate).
